title: Sorceress and Severed Head
description: A surreal macabre scene shows a green-robed sorceress with a white mask and pointed red hat standing behind a stone table. She holds a severed classical head by a thick purple snake that emerges from its neck; the head has red glowing eyes and vines growing from it. The table is covered in scattered papers and colorful paint splatters. An all-seeing eye with red tears floats above.
prompt: A surreal occult illustration of a masked sorceress in a flowing green robe and tall red pointed hat, standing behind a stone table covered in papers and vibrant paint splatters. She holds up a severed classical male head with glowing red eyes and vines growing from it, the head impaled on a thick purple snake. An all-seeing eye with dripping red tears floats above in a frame of roses and bookshelves, intricate black and white line art with selective vivid color accents.
